description: This file is a header file for the HIP9011/TPIC8101 driver, defining macros and function prototypes related to the driver initialization and configuration.

methods.name: initHip9011
methods.description: Initializes the HIP9011 driver with shared logging.

methods.name: setHip9011FrankensoPinout
methods.description: Configures the pinout for the HIP9011 for a specific hardware setup.

methods.name: hipAdcCallback
methods.description: Callback function for ADC samples, enabled if HAL_USE_ADC is defined.

methods.name: setHipGain
methods.description: Sets the gain value for the HIP9011.

methods.name: setHipBand
methods.description: Sets the bandwidth for the HIP9011.

methods.name: setPrescalerAndSDO
methods.description: Sets prescaler and SDO configuration values.

methods.name: setMaxKnockSubDeg
methods.description: Sets the maximum knock subtraction in degrees.
